intro: Text chat on your own website or app. Shares the same AI brain, knowledge base and customer record as the voice agent, and hands over to a person when needed.
Part of Spectrum’s [AI Contact Center](service:ai-contact-center): take the whole seven-part system, or only the parts you need. Every part shares one customer record.

sections.title: The same person, on every channel
body: A caller who first asked a question by phone and later writes in the chat is recognised as the same person, with the earlier conversation already on screen.
